brand.name: UniUni
brand.description: Canadian last-mile delivery company founded in 2019, using a crowd-sourced driver model (similar to Uber) for affordable, fast parcel delivery. Operates in 180+ cities across 9 Canadian provinces with major US expansion underway. Ranked #4 on Globe and Mail's Top Growing Firms with 12,854% three-year growth. Offers e-commerce shipping, cross-border US-to-Canada delivery, and same-day/next-day options.
